move_outcome.storage_failures_overlap_note: counted inside the three buckets above, not in addition to them

profitability.note: P/L is the client's profit on the flagged trade, so a larger total is a larger cost to the house. This is a GROSS total of flagged wins: the watchdog records no losing trades, so it is not a net figure.

volume_over_time.clock: Close Time (the trade's own clock), not the watchdog's Logs stamp

by_symbol.note: Top 10 of 10 symbols by detection count.

by_account.note: Top 10 of 20 accounts, ranked by total client profit on flagged trades.

skipped_reasons.reason: duplicate ticket re-logged by the watchdog

clock_offset.note: The watchdog's Logs stamp runs ahead of the trade's Close Time. Time series on this page use Close Time.

coverage.tuning_note: 23 detections is below the 30 this page treats as the minimum for reading a threshold off a distribution. Listed as events, not tuned against.
coverage.layout_note: A group-path column was added after Target PG without updating the header, rows are mapped by field count, so a move recorded in the newer layout is not misread as a group name.

caveats: Window start/end: priority 0 is the MT5 USER log itself (the exact 'Group: A -> B' change and its timestamp), when the log has no matching row the start falls back to the trigger and the end falls back to a hand-verified override (protection_window_overrides), then the next observed group_moves row that moves the account OUT of the toxic group, then the algo's own expiry rule. Check each row's window_source.
MachineGun expiry rule (no observed restore): trigger + 6h (MACHINEGUN_TATTOO_ACTIVE_HOURS).

FBU expiry rule (no observed restore): midnight America/Toronto, 2 day(s) after the trigger's Toronto DATE (FBU_ACTIVE_DAYS) -- a late-evening trigger can therefore yield well under 48h, that is expected, not a bug.
".XS" symbols are excluded -- that flow is passed to the LP (A-book), so no markup accrues to the house.

Rows before 2026-06-26 predate the restore sweep running reliably: accounts sat in the toxic group far longer than the algo intended, so protection figures from that period are inflated by an operational gap, not algo behaviour. See the Flag column / pre-cutoff split.
Data window: every real MachineGun/FBU move ever ingested (same scope as Algo Protection's 'All' range) -- see /api/risk-analysis/protection?all=1 for the same moves as a flat table.
Toxic window start/end and tier derivation are shared with /api/risk-analysis/protection (algo_protection.resolve_window / catch tier config) -- the two pages cannot disagree.
